steps.en: Install the SDK and point it at the API
steps.zh: 安装 SDK，指向它的 API
steps.code: npm install supermemory · pip install supermemory

steps.en: Push the raw conversation turn, tagged per user
steps.zh: 把原始对话轮次推给它，按用户打标签

steps.en: Extracts facts, resolves contradictions, expires temporary ones
steps.zh: 抽取事实、消解矛盾、让过期信息自动失效

steps.en: Keeps a static + dynamic profile per user, always fresh
steps.zh: 为每个用户维护静态＋动态画像，持续更新

steps.en: Before the next reply, fetch profile + relevant context
steps.zh: 下次回复前，一次取回画像＋相关记忆

steps.en: Returns profile facts and hybrid-search memories in one call
steps.zh: 一次调用返回画像事实与混合检索记忆

value.en: Your agent knows who it is talking to from the first sentence — no vector DB, embedding pipeline, or chunking strategy to operate
value.zh: agent 第一句话就知道对面是谁——你不必运维向量库、embedding 管线或分块策略
